Phase spans differ by backend and are inclusive; no exclusive Z3/symbolic claim.
JVM service retains a process-level OnceLock Viper/JVM; native constructs a frontend per request.
Process cleanup tracks observed descendants and cannot prove all escapes.
Three pairs give limited variability evidence; timeouts and invalid observations are retained.
